_about: The three Always Free sessions offered on wehale.io/breathe. A session is playable when public/breathe/sessions/<slug>/score.json and audio.mp3 both exist at build time; until then its choice shows 'Coming soon'. next_en is the end-screen suggestion after finishing it. world: the room's colour on the start screen in the landing variants (a, b, c) and during that session; v=0 keeps Ember for all. reason_en: the one reason line on the tiles in variants d and e.
